sculptor.linePrev: Poets agonize, they cannot find the words
sculptor.line: And the stone stares at the sculptor, asks "Are you absurd?"
sculptor.lineNext: The painter paints his brushes black
stanza: Poets agonize, they cannot find the words
And the stone stares at the sculptor, asks "Are you absurd?"
The painter paints his brushes black
Through the canvas runs a crack
Portrait of the pain never answers back
But nobody's buying flowers from the flower lady
